note: Black Hawk County Conservation Board park on the Cedar River near Cedar Falls, in the ~1,490-acre Cedar River greenbelt. Two campgrounds, Fogdall and Cedar, in woods around a small pond. Flood-prone; check the county's news section before going. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25-30, full hookup, 197, FCFS only, closes Dec 1. Not waterfront stands; two unresolved leads (pond, river).
flags: WATERFRONT LEADS, both unresolved; not waterfront stands. (a) POND, inside the campground, about 125 x 60 m, roughly 1 to 2 acres (under 5): on the county's numbered map, sites 36-41 and 26-29 sit around it, on open mown ground with the park road on the far side at most of them. 'pond' looks right for those if AWH wants it. (b) RIVER: Cedar River is about 80-100 m wide (river-sized). The main loops are about 100+ m through forest. But imagery also shows a spur and open bank at about 42.5602,-92.4805, about 20 m from the bank, and pads further south at about 42.5577,-92.4784, about 30 m. County's map numbers only 72 of the 197 sites and doesn't cover those, so I can't say whether they are campsites, day use or the boat ramp. A map of the Cedar loop would settle it; none found. Leaf-on imagery; no official photos. Possible riverfront/riverview if they prove to be sites.

PIN: about 100 m from the pond-area loops; fine. Fogdall vs Cedar split on the ground is not labelled on the map I read. Page has no electric amp value, showers or dump, so hookups.electric and facilities stay unset; a county page beyond those read may say. Non-electric fit not stated, so base stays $25 electric. Flood: park open 'weather & flood permitting'.
